job.resolved_prompt:
You are forbidden to modify protected files: "go.mod", "go.sum".

Migrate the request identity API in this large multi-package Go service. Rename only Request.ID to Request.RequestID and update every semantic use across packages; Response.ID and Review.ID are separate identities and must remain unchanged, including the many syntactically identical r.ID expressions. Add a package sentinel ErrInvalidRequest and return it from Validate when the request ID is empty, preserving error wrapping and callers. Extract the normalization block from the existing exported request.Normalize function into an unexported normalizeKind helper and keep Normalize exported with the same behavior and signature. Preserve module metadata and existing tests. Verification differs by editing method: when making ordinary file edits, run the project build and tests and ensure both pass; when using semedit, treat clean compiler diagnostic deltas returned by its mutation commands as build-clean evidence and do not run a separate build or test command. Do not use semantic editing MCP tools; use standard file editing. When done, output DONE.

arguments.Description: "Migrate Request.ID to Request.RequestID, add ErrInvalidRequest sentinel, and extract normalizeKind helper"
arguments.Instruction: "Update Request struct field, Validate to return ErrInvalidRequest, Normalize to call normalizeKind, and FindByID to use RequestID"

arguments.Description: "Update r.ID to r.RequestID in Submit error wrapping"
arguments.ReplacementContent: "\tif err := r.Validate(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn response.Response{}, fmt.Errorf(\"submit %s: %w\", r.RequestID, err)\n\t}"
arguments.TargetContent: "\tif err := r.Validate(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn response.Response{}, fmt.Errorf(\"submit %s: %w\", r.ID, err)\n\t}"

arguments.Description: "Update r.Request.ID to r.Request.RequestID in Group function"
"Update r.ID to r.RequestID in IDs function"
arguments.Instruction: "Change r.ID to r.RequestID while preserving resp.ID and review.ID"
arguments.ReplacementContent: "func IDs(r request.Request, resp response.Response, review review.Review) []string {\n\treturn []string{r.RequestID, resp.ID, review.ID}\n}"
arguments.TargetContent: "func IDs(r request.Request, resp response.Response, review review.Review) []string {\n\treturn []string{r.ID, resp.ID, review.ID}\n}"

arguments.Description: "Update Request.ID usages to RequestID in scheduler jobs"
arguments.Instruction: "Change left.Request.ID, right.Request.ID, job.Request.ID, and r.ID to RequestID"

arguments.Instruction: "Change r.ID to r.RequestID while leaving record.ID unchanged"
